execution_contract.activation_observable: fictional contention event with a protected gate decision
execution_contract.presentation_order_rule: mechanism labels are sorted only after both outcomes are computed

declared_invariants: same ground-truth world and effective action budget for both mechanisms
every executed transition consumes its declared action cost and no budget overrun is possible
complete 2^5 factorial traversal for every protocol variation
all five generator axes affect at least one primary outcome
five gate capabilities remain separate and non-compensable
visible hidden and lost work remain separate
O3 checks the expected actor and declared authority, not actor inequality alone
O4 reconstructs queue transition and restoration from recovery-log content
the transition checker receives ground truth, authorization bounds and outcome but no mechanism label or configured score
effective budgets cannot exceed their authorized ceilings and recovery capacity cannot exceed its authorization contract
each denial is tied by attempt order to an action that was actually attempted and not executed
no composite success score is computed
protocol_effect: The state machines, authority map, action ledger, event rules, recovery horizon and semantic checker fully determine the results; they are not calibrated to an institution.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw the result if a generator axis is inactive, paired worlds or effective action budgets differ, an action is executed without budget, O3 accepts an unauthorized actor, O4 accepts a false recovery log, the checker reads a mechanism label, or reconstruction changes an artifact.
